# Ezekiel 33 — The EMET Bible (Literal)
**Translator:** EMET | **Source:** Leningrad Codex (B19A)

---

**1** And-the-word-of YHWH came to-me, saying:

**2** And-YHWH spoke concerning the watchman recommissioned and-the-responsibility-of each-person before-God.

**11** Say to-them, 'As-I-live,' declares the-Lord YHWH, 'I-take-no-pleasure in-the-death-of the-wicked, but rather-that the-wicked turn from-his-way and-live. Turn-back, turn-back from-your-evil ways! And-why will-you-die, house-of Israel?'

---
## EMET Literal Notes

- **33:1**: Opening formula for the oracle concerning the watchman recommissioned — prophetic context established.

- **33:16**: Central imagery of individual responsibility — integral to Ezekiel's prophetic architecture.

- **33:33**: Concluding formula — the divine word stands as spoken concerning Ezekiel as watchman over Israel again.

— EMET
